1.web: Yahweh reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!
1.asv: Jehovah reigneth; let the earth rejoice; Let the multitude of isles be glad.

2.web: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
2.asv: Clouds and darkness are round about him: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

3.web: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.
3.asv: A fire goeth before him, And burneth up his adversaries round about.

4.web: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.
4.asv: His lightnings lightened the world: The earth saw, and trembled.

5.web: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of Yahweh, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
5.asv: The mountains melted like wax at the presence of Jehovah, At the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

6.web: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.
6.asv: The heavens declare his righteousness, And all the peoples have seen his glory.

7.web: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!
7.asv: Let all them be put to shame that serve graven images, That boast themselves of idols: Worship him, all ye gods.

8.web: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced, because of your judgments, Yahweh.
8.asv: Zion heard and was glad, And the daughters of Judah rejoiced, Because of thy judgments, O Jehovah.

9.web: For you, Yahweh, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.
9.asv: For thou, Jehovah, art most high above all the earth: Thou art exalted far above all gods.

10.web: You who love Yahweh, hate evil. He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
10.asv: O ye that love Jehovah, hate evil: He preserveth the souls of his saints; He delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.

11.web: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
11.asv: Light is sown for the righteous, And gladness for the upright in heart.

12.web: Be glad in Yahweh, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.
12.asv: Be glad in Jehovah, ye righteous; And give thanks to his holy memorial name.
